record.title_md: Hamilton decomposition of prisms over 3-connected cubic planar graphs

dossier_meta.catalog_title: Hamilton decomposition of prisms over 3-connected cubic planar graphs
dossier_meta.subject: Graph Theory » Basic Graph Theory » Cycles
dossier_meta.statement_text: Conjecture Every prism over a $ 3 $ -connected cubic planar graph can be decomposed into two Hamilton cycles.
dossier_meta.context_text: The prism over a graph $ G $ is the Cartesian product $ G\square K_2 $ . Rosenfeld and Barnette [RB] deduced from the Four-Colour Theorem that the prism over cubic planar 3-connected $ G $ has a Hamilton cycle $ C $ . The graph $ G\setminus E(C) $ is cycle factor (spanning union of cycles). The conjecture says that one can choses $ C $ so that the cycle factor $ G\setminus E(C) $ has a unique cycle, that is a Hamilton cycle.
dossier_meta.references_text:
- *[AR] B. Alspach and M. Rosenfeld, On Hamilton decompositions of prisms over simple -polytopes. Graphs Combin. 2 (1986), 1--8.
- [RB] M. Rosenfeld and D. Barnette, Hamiltonian circuits in certain prisms, Discrete Math. 5 (1973) 389–394.
